summary: Completed comprehensive testing of GenestLoula e-commerce site. Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in admin CRUD endpoints. All 28 backend API tests pass. Frontend homepage, cart, and admin pages all functional.

fixed.issue: MongoDB ObjectId not serializable - insert_one adds _id to document causing 500 error
fixed.fix: Added doc.pop('_id', None) after insert_one to remove ObjectId before returning response

issues: Using cdn.tailwindcss.com in production - should use compiled CSS for better performance

critical_code_review_comments: MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue was fixed - ensure all insert operations exclude _id from response
Consider using compiled Tailwind CSS instead of CDN for production
seed_data_creation: Database seeded with 6 products, 2 events, 3 testimonials via seed_data.py
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features tested and working. Backend API tests in /app/backend/tests/test_genestloula_api.py cover all CRUD operations. MongoDB ObjectId bug was fixed by removing _id from response after insert_one operations.
